rules.name: Real-time Inventory Consistency
rules.statement: The system must prevent any order assignment if the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot indicates insufficient quantity for all requested items.
rules.condition: during order allocation to a store
rules.if_violated: The order is rejected and flagged for manual review to prevent overselling and revenue loss.
rules.rationale: Overselling leads to failed deliveries, customer dissatisfaction, and financial penalties.

parameters.name: minimum_available_quantity
parameters.description: the required stock level for each item in the order

rules.name: Discrepancy Investigation Threshold
rules.statement: The system must automatically trigger a Discrepancy Alert when the difference between physical stock counts and system records exceeds the configured tolerance limit.
rules.condition: during periodic inventory reconciliation or upon manual count upload
rules.if_violated: The discrepancy is logged, and the store partner is notified to initiate a physical audit before further sales of that SKU.
rules.rationale: Early detection of data drift prevents compounding errors and ensures accurate availability data.

parameters.name: tolerance_limit
parameters.description: the maximum allowed variance between physical and digital counts

rules.name: Overselling Incident Escalation
rules.statement: The system must escalate any confirmed overselling incident to the Compliance Officer immediately, regardless of the order status.
rules.condition: when an overselling event is confirmed via audit or customer dispute
rules.if_violated: The incident is recorded as a compliance breach, and the store partner's settlement is held pending investigation.
rules.rationale: Overselling represents a critical failure of trust and regulatory risk that requires immediate senior oversight.

parameters.name: escalation_priority
parameters.description: the urgency level assigned to the incident

rules.name: Partial Fulfillment Restriction
rules.statement: The system must not allow an order to proceed with partial fulfillment unless the customer explicitly consents to a split shipment.
rules.condition: when inventory is insufficient for the full order but sufficient for some items
rules.if_violated: The order is held in a pending state until full inventory is available or the customer cancels.
rules.rationale: Splitting orders without consent creates confusion, delays, and potential revenue loss due to partial cancellations.

parameters.name: split_shipment_threshold
parameters.description: the minimum percentage of items required to trigger a split option
